fields.label: ID
fields.name: id
fields.instructions: Optional ID. Use #my-id to link directly to this accordion. When opened via the URL, the accordion opens automatically and scrolls into view.

fields.name: close_neighbouring_accordions
fields.instructions: Automatically closes adjacent open accordions when this one is opened.

fields.name: scroll_to_accordion_top
fields.instructions: Automatically scrolls to the start of the accordion when opened. Especially useful on mobile with long content.

sub_fields.name: add_to_faq_schema
sub_fields.instructions: Uses this accordion’s content as question and answer for structured FAQ data. Only use for real FAQs.

fields.label: Anchor ID
fields.name: id
fields.instructions: Unique ID for this anchor. Use lowercase letters and hyphens only. Use #my-id to link directly to this position or scroll there automatically when the page loads.

fields.label: Offset
fields.name: offset
fields.instructions: Optional offset in pixels when auto-scrolling.

fields.label: Content type
fields.name: post_type
fields.instructions: After changing, save and reload the page so the category options update.

fields.label: Category
fields.name: post_taxonomy
fields.instructions: Filters the list by a category.

fields.name: has_category_filters
fields.instructions: Shows category filters above the list.

fields.label: Slides
fields.name: hero_slides
fields.instructions: One slide shows a static hero. Two or more become a slider.

sub_fields.label: Caption
sub_fields.name: label
sub_fields.instructions: Text below the number.

sub_fields.label: Prefix
sub_fields.name: prefix
sub_fields.instructions: Text before the number.

sub_fields.label: Suffix
sub_fields.name: suffix
sub_fields.instructions: Text after the number.

fields.name: navigation
fields.instructions: Shows navigation arrows for the previous and next slide.

fields.name: pagination
fields.instructions: Shows the current slider position below the slides.

fields.name: dynamic_bullets
fields.instructions: Shows only pagination dots near the current slide.

fields.name: loop
fields.instructions: After the last slide, the slider starts again from the beginning.

fields.name: autoplay
fields.instructions: The slider starts automatically. User actions such as swiping or clicking interrupt autoplay.

fields.label: Autoplay duration
fields.name: autoplay_delay
fields.instructions: Time between automatic slide changes in seconds.

fields.name: has_content
fields.instructions: Enables heading, text, and buttons on all slides.

sub_fields.label: Icon
sub_fields.name: icon
sub_fields.instructions: Enter an icon class like -icon-name (or just the name). Browse the library under Settings → Developer → System.

fields.message: Add structured data for your website here. This helps search engines understand your company and content and can improve how it appears in search results.

sub_fields.label: Type
sub_fields.name: type
sub_fields.instructions: Choose the Schema.org type that best describes the website or organization.

sub_fields.label: Company name
sub_fields.name: organization_name
sub_fields.instructions: The official name of the company or organization.

sub_fields.label: Description
sub_fields.name: description
sub_fields.instructions: A short description of the company. 120–160 characters recommended.

sub_fields.label: Logo
sub_fields.name: logo
sub_fields.instructions: The main company logo. Preferably an SVG or high-resolution PNG.

sub_fields.label: Image
sub_fields.name: image
sub_fields.instructions: A representative image of the company, e.g. office, store, or team.

sub_fields.label: Phone number
sub_fields.name: phone
sub_fields.instructions: The main phone number, preferably in international format (e.g. +49 821 123456).

sub_fields.label: Email address
sub_fields.name: email
sub_fields.instructions: The main contact email address.

sub_fields.label: Website
sub_fields.name: website
sub_fields.instructions: The website URL. Leave empty to use the site address automatically.

sub_fields.label: Street
sub_fields.name: street
sub_fields.instructions: Street name and house number.

sub_fields.label: Country
sub_fields.name: country
sub_fields.instructions: Country name or ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code (e.g. Germany or DE).

sub_fields.label: Social media profiles
sub_fields.name: social_profiles
sub_fields.instructions: Add links to official social media or public profiles.

fields.message: Show site-wide notice popups for visitors. If more than one notice is enabled and matches the current page and schedule, the first entry in the list is shown.

sub_fields.label: Enabled
sub_fields.name: enabled
sub_fields.instructions: If more than one notice is enabled, the first matching notice takes priority.

sub_fields.label: Start date and time
sub_fields.name: start
sub_fields.instructions: If empty, the notice is treated as already started.

sub_fields.label: End date and time
sub_fields.name: end
sub_fields.instructions: If empty, the notice has no end date.

sub_fields.label: Show again
sub_fields.name: show_again
sub_fields.instructions: Controls when the notice appears again after it has been shown.

sub_fields.label: Show again after
sub_fields.name: show_again_after
sub_fields.instructions: Number of days after showing before the notice can appear again.

sub_fields.label: Extra CSS classes
sub_fields.name: extra_class
sub_fields.instructions: Separate multiple classes with spaces.
